title: Diagnosis
description: What a session's passes say about the car: computed evidence, ranked hypotheses with their alternatives and candidate experiments, and an explanation in words. Every number is in `evidence`; the explanation adds none.

evidence.description: The evidence pack: every computed number a hypothesis or the explanation may cite.

Evidence.title: Evidence
Evidence.description: One computed number: the mean of a metric over the valid passes of a corner class.

id.description: Metric id and corner class, for example front_slip_mid_deg.slow.

Alternative.title: Alternative
Alternative.description: Another explanation of the same symptom that a setup change would not cure.

supported.description: True when the evidence speaks for this alternative; false when it could only not be ruled out.

evidence.description: Ids of the evidence it rests on.

Candidate.title: Candidate
Candidate.description: One experiment that would test the hypothesis: one setup item moved by a number of clicks.

parameter.description: Item id in the game's setup.

clicks.description: Clicks to move the item by; negative lowers the raw value.

why.description: The rule of thumb behind the candidate. A prior, not a measurement.

expects.description: Which way each response channel should move if the hypothesis is right.

Hypothesis.title: Hypothesis
Hypothesis.description: A testable statement about the car, with the evidence for it and what else could explain it.

key.description: Stable id of the symptom, for example mid_understeer.slow.

score.description: How far the symptom is beyond its threshold, lowered when an alternative is supported. Only for ranking.

evidence.description: Ids of the evidence the hypothesis rests on.

alternatives.description: Always includes driver input and conditions.

candidates.description: Experiments on this car that would test it, in the rule table's order.

not_testable.description: Knobs the rule table names that cannot be tested here, each with the reason.

Explanation.title: Explanation
Explanation.description: The diagnosis in words. Written from the evidence pack by a language model or, without one, from templates. It carries no number that is not in the pack.

provider.description: Who wrote the text that is shown.

ranking.description: The hypotheses in the order the writer would test them, each with its reason.

hypothesis.description: Key of a hypothesis of this diagnosis.

cites.description: Ids of the evidence the reason rests on.

rejected.description: Why a language model's reply was thrown away and the template text is shown instead; empty when nothing was rejected.
